h200_consumer.reason: The exact workload never crosses the admitted guard: both arms would replay the same 58 graph buckets. A causal H200 pair would require changing the forbidden workload, chunk size, or capture buckets, so no in-scope nonduplicate real consumer command exists.

local_implementation.classification: minimum offline official-method rebase through the real ScheduleBatch-to-ForwardBatch-to-PrefillCudaGraphRunner ownership chain; no CUDA execution claim

chain.contract: Owns per-request extend ranges under the 2048 token budget; the carried chunk is completed first and the remainder may start the next request.
Flattens request-owned uncached token slices into one input_ids tensor and records extend lengths and positions.

Calls PrefillCudaGraphRunner.can_run_graph for EXTEND; true dispatches execute, false dispatches EagerRunner.execute on the same live ForwardBatch.
Derives raw rows from len(forward_batch.input_ids), selects the next captured token bucket, and rejects only when the bucket is greater than two times raw rows.
